# task-bd962d9b: intersect nonzero markers across divider-separated panels

## When to use
Use for task-bd962d9b when a single solid row or column divides equal-sized panels and the output is a single panel. The demos establish a nonzero-occupancy intersection, not color equality.

## Validated rule
A solid single-color vertical or horizontal divider separates two equal-sized panels. Align corresponding positions in each panel. Output dimensions equal one panel. Output color 2 exactly where BOTH aligned cells are nonzero (foreground/marker), and 0 everywhere else.
